name: orcamcp
description: Slice with your own OrcaSlicer presets and printers, guided: it asks printer, filament, process and orientation, then advises (supports, orientation, profile) with measured alternatives.
long_description: Uses the OrcaSlicer CLI with your own user presets (including presets that inherit from system ones, which the CLI cannot resolve on its own in OrcaSlicer 2.5). Works on a private copy of your presets; never writes to your OrcaSlicer folder and never overwrites files.

default_printer.title: Default printer preset
default_printer.description: Name or part of it, e.g. 'AD5M Pro 0.4'. Empty = simplest user printer. You can change the active printer anytime by asking Claude (set_printer).
